experiments.study_type: Whole-body plethysmography of ventilatory responses to hypoxic-hypercapnic gas challenge after L,D-DTT injection
experiments.procedure_text: Rats received IV vehicle or L,D-DTT, then 15 min later a 60-min hypoxic-hypercapnic gas challenge with ventilatory parameters recorded by plethysmography.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: received an injection of L,D-DTT (100 μmol/kg, IV). After 15 min, both groups received a HH gas challenge
experiments.animal_counts_evidence: One group of rats (n = 6, 326 ± 2 g) received an injection of vehicle
experiments.test_system_evidence: record ventilatory parameters in freely-moving rats

endpoints.label: Ventilatory parameters (Freq, TV, MV, Ti, Te, PIF, PEF, inspiratory/expiratory drive, NEBI)
endpoints.evidence: used to record ventilatory parameters in freely-moving rats

endpoints.label: Body temperature
endpoints.evidence: We recorded rat body temperatures before (Pre-drug) and at various timepoints

substances.name: L,D-DTT
substances.evidence: received an injection of L,D-DTT (100 μmol/kg, IV)

substances.name: vehicle
substances.evidence: received an injection of vehicle (100 μL/kg, IV)

exposure.timing: After 15 min, both groups received a HH gas challenge for 60 min
exposure.conditions: temperature of 21.2 ± 0.2 °C and relative humidity of 51 ± 2%

experiments.exposure_evidence: received an injection of L,D-DTT (100 μmol/kg, IV). After 15 min, both groups received a HH gas challenge for 60 min
experiments.regulatory_evidence: performed according to the NIH Guide for Care and Use of Laboratory Animals
experiments.notes: Study 1. Two separate batches of 3 rats per group were used. Body temperature recorded via rectal thermometer in a related cohort (n = 6).
